summary.text: Alex Wait is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
A writer from Granger, he lists public school funding, utility costs and nonpartisan redistricting among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Alex Wait graduated from Penn High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Xavier University in 2016 and a graduate degree from King's College London in 2020.
His career experience includes working as a writer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Granger, where his family has lived for 25 years, and worked as a scriptwriter for a YouTube channel.

Wait said his key messages are funding public schools instead of what he called school choice, using the state budget surplus to improve the power grid, and requiring data-center companies to disclose project costs to communities before construction.
He also said he would introduce bills to strengthen biometric privacy law and to create a nonpartisan redistricting commission.
Endorsers he listed include former U.S. Senator Joe Donnelly, State Representatives Maureen Bauer and Ryan Dvorak, IBEW Local 153 and the Indiana Reproductive Freedom PAC.
